definitions.explanation: The morning of the next day; the morning after a referenced event.

examples.japanese: {翌朝|よくあさ}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: The next morning, he woke up early.

examples.japanese: {翌朝|よくあさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It had already arrived by the next morning.

examples.japanese: {翌朝|よくあさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I went to bed early in preparation for the next morning's departure.

examples.japanese: {翌朝|よくあさ}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めると→覚める：02058_sameru⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I woke up the next morning, the outside was covered in white snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦すぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦せいで→せいで：20743_seide⟧、{翌朝|よくあさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{起|お}きられなかった→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Because I drank too much until late at night, the next morning I had a headache and could barely get up.

notes:
{翌朝|よくあさ} is a compound of ⟦{翌|よく}→翌：03970_yoku⟧ (next, following) + ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning). It refers to the morning after a previously mentioned event or time, and is primarily used in written or narrative contexts.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧:
{翌朝|よくあさ} is more formal and literary. In casual speech, ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ or ⟦{明|あ}くる→明くる：28093_akuru⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ is used instead.

RELATED {翌|よく} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the following day
- ⟦{翌週|よくしゅう}→翌週：25325_yokushuu⟧: the following week
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the following month
- ⟦{翌年|よくとし}→翌年：03184_yokutoshi⟧: the following year

The ⟦{翌|よく}→翌〜：03970_yoku⟧ prefix always refers to the next instance relative to a past reference point, not relative to the present moment.
